ctaHeading: Truganina's tiling team is ready — let's bring your ideas to life.
aboutText: With 25 years of hands-on tiling experience, Sergio Tiling has been transforming homes across Truganina and Melbourne's western suburbs. From complete bathroom renovations to kitchen backsplashes and outdoor slate repairs, we take pride in real craftsmanship, transparent communication, and results you'll love. Whether it's a full ensuite rebuild or a simple tile repair, Sergio and his dedicated team bring precision, care, and honest advice to every project.
servicesText: From full bathroom renovations to small tile repairs, Sergio Tiling offers comprehensive tiling services across Truganina and surrounding suburbs in Melbourne's west. We handle everything from initial design and consultation through to planning, preparation, and execution with final touches. No job is too big or too small — we bring real craftsmanship to every project.

services.title: Bathroom & Ensuite Renovations
services.desc: Complete bathroom transformations including demolition, rebuilding, waterproofing, and precision tiling — we revive worn surfaces with confidence and care.

services.title: Kitchen Backsplash Tiling
services.desc: Expertly installed kitchen backsplashes that add style and protection to your kitchen, crafted with exceptional attention to detail.

services.title: Waterproofing & Demolition
services.desc: Professional demolition of old tiles and thorough waterproofing to ensure your renovation is built to last with precision.

services.title: Floor & Wall Tiling
services.desc: High-quality floor and wall tiling for bathrooms, laundries, and living spaces, delivering clean and professional finishes every time.

services.title: Outdoor & Slate Tile Repair
services.desc: Reviving worn outdoor tiles and broken slate surfaces with confidence, precision, and durable craftsmanship built to last.

services.title: Design & Consultation
services.desc: Personalised design advice and planning to help bring your tiling ideas to life with clear, honest guidance.

reviews.text: Sergio renovated our ensuite, bathroom, toilet and laundry to a very high standard. He was always on time, very pleasant to deal with and accommodating with all our requests. The work started and finished on schedule as estimated. Highly recommend Sergio Tiling.
reviews.name: Gordon Ross

reviews.text: Sergio re-tiled our 30-year-old shower which needed to be demolished, rebuilt and waterproofed. The job was done quickly and Sergio's craftsmanship was incredible. The shower looks great and has solved all of our problems. Highly recommend!
reviews.name: Caroline M

reviews.text: We first engaged Sergio for our ensuite renovation and then six months later for the bathroom. His work is of a very high quality and he coordinated all the other trades needed. Sergio brings in highly skilled people and his honesty eases any renovation stress.
reviews.name: Andrew P
